William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

Songs of Innocence

Infant Joy

‘I 
HAVE
 no name:
I am but two days old.’
What shall I call thee?
‘I happy am,
Joy is my name.’
Sweet joy befall thee!
Pretty Joy!
Sweet Joy, but two days old.
Sweet Joy I call thee:
Thou dost smile,
I sing the while,
Sweet joy befall thee!
